products.name: LevelZero.NET
products.tagline: Native Intel GPU Acceleration & Managed Level Zero Runtime for .NET 10
products.summary: High-performance, zero-allocation managed .NET bindings for Intel oneAPI Level Zero runtime with built-in pre-compiled SPIR-V and .zebin kernel catalogs across 11 Intel GPU architectures.

products.name: l0llm
products.tagline: Pure C# & Intel Level Zero LLM Runner and OpenAI-Compatible REST Server
products.summary: Ultra-fast, zero-allocation native LLM runner for Intel GPUs (Iris Xe, Arc A-Series, Lunar Lake, Arrow Lake, Battlemage). Benchmarked at 41.3 tok/s on Iris Xe with zero GC allocations and zero Python dependencies.

products.name: l0check
products.tagline: Intel Level Zero Hardware Diagnostics & Validation CLI Tool
products.summary: Fast, standalone command-line diagnostic tool for inspecting Intel GPU architectures, driver capabilities, memory topologies, and validating compute kernel execution via Intel oneAPI Level Zero.

products.name: ML.Agentic
products.tagline: Zero-Dependency Agentic AI Patterns & Protocol Engine for .NET 10
products.summary: Production-grade .NET 10 foundation providing 21 canonical agentic patterns alongside native protocol implementations for Model Context Protocol (MCP), Agent2Agent (A2A), and JSON-RPC 2.0 with 0 external package dependencies.

products.name: Poplar.NET
products.tagline: Enterprise .NET 10 Runtime & Resident Graph Engine for Graphcore IPUs
products.summary: Production-grade, zero-allocation C# / .NET 10 runtime engine and graph orchestration SDK for Graphcore Colossus IPUs (Bow-2000, MK2, IPU-POD). Includes native Poplar graph bindings, resident graphs, PopART ONNX runners, and IPU fan governor.
